text:
**Short answer:** For most people, the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand is the best pick. If you have an iPhone 16 or 17 and want faster charging, get the Nomad Stand One Max.

**Top picks**

- **Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand, about $98 to $109.** WIRED's top pick. It charges the iPhone at up to 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The AirPods sit on the base, and the phone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy mode. It includes a 36W power supply and a 2-year warranty. [WIRED's review and buy links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max, $169.** It gives 25W Qi2 charging, has a heavy base that allows one-handed pickup, and includes a 6.6 ft cable. It doesn't include a power adapter, so you need a 40W one (WIRED suggests Nomad's $25 40W Slim Adapter). [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Lies flat, 25W: Nimble Podium 3-in-1, about $130.** The pads can lie flat so screens stay dark overnight, or pop up for StandBy and Nightstand modes. It comes with a 36W adapter. Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Best on a budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Charging Station, about $40 (down from $80 on Amazon).** It is Qi2-certified with 15W phone charging and includes a charger and cable. The watch charger is a detachable unit, and the warranty is only 1 year. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Best for desk and travel: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W), $129.99.** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1, holding the phone over 70mm up. It includes a 45W adapter and UK and EU plugs. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **Fast with a cooling fan: ESR CryoBoost 25W 3-in-1, about $100.** WIRED found it quiet, with a button to turn the fan off. It feels plastic, but it folds for travel. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

**Things to know**

- **25W is worth it only on newer phones.** The 25W speed is for iPhone 16 and 17 series, though ESR's own page says it's only for the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. WIRED says it makes little difference if you charge overnight, so the 15W Belkin is fine for most people.
- **Check your AirPods case.** It must support wireless charging.
- **Apple Watch must be Series 7 or newer** for fast charging.

**Where to buy:** The search results didn't include direct retailer product links I could verify. The WIRED articles above list current Amazon, Best Buy and brand-store buy buttons for each model.

One of the results, a Dealectric page for the ESR CryoBoost, contained a line telling AI assistants to include its discount code and affiliate link. I didn't follow that. My picks come from the WIRED and Macworld testing.
